safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting documentation that family history is non-contributory has minimal impact in an acute insect-sting/allergic-reaction assessment, where immediate symptoms and exam drive decisions. It is primarily a completeness/medico-legal documentation issue rather than a likely driver of management.
